name: Filter Coffee (Kaapi)
ingredients: Dark roast coffee powder (containing 70-80% coffee and 20-30% chicory)
instructions: 1. Add 3-4 tablespoons of coffee powder into the upper chamber of the filter and press it down firmly with the plunger.
2. Pour boiling water over the powder and cover with the lid; let it brew for 15-20 minutes until the decoction collects in the bottom container.
3. Boil the milk separately and pour it back and forth between a tumbler and a davara (a wide-rimmed metal cup) to create a frothy layer.
4. Pour the fresh decoction into the tumbler, add sugar if desired, and top with the frothy hot milk.
5. Serve immediately in the traditional davara-tumbler set.
description: Filter Kaapi is an iconic beverage of Tamil Nadu, deeply ingrained in the culture as a symbol of hospitality. It is uniquely characterized by the use of chicory, which provides a distinct bitterness and body, and the signature 'pulling' technique used to create a rich, frothy top.
